definition: A form used to correct or amend a previously filed individual income tax return, allowing taxpayers to report changes to income, deductions, credits, filing status, or other tax items for a specific tax year.

includes.text: Form used to amend a previously filed individual income tax return
includes.quote: Amended U.S. Individual Income Tax Return

includes.text: Contains columns for original amounts, changes, and corrected amounts
Requires explanation of all changes made

excludes.text: Dividend and distribution information from corporations and funds
Original annual income tax return for individuals

discriminators.text: This form amends a previously filed return and requires explanation of changes; the sibling reports mortgage interest paid during the year with no amendment capability
discriminators.quote: Amended U.S. Individual Income Tax Return

discriminators.text: This form allows correction of tax liability across multiple line items; the sibling reports only dividend and distribution amounts from a single source
This form shows original and corrected amounts in separate columns for comparison; the sibling is the original return filed for the tax year
